title: [Main]-Project Ledger Entry does not get the modified amount from Purchase Order Statistics if the Purchase line is of type G/L Account in the Spanish version.
summary: Fixed a bug where project ledger entries did not reflect modified invoice discounts on G/L Account lines in purchase orders, even though G/L entries were correct.
key_points: Project ledger entries now use the correct unit cost when partial invoices are posted with modified invoice discounts on G/L Account lines
Two new procedures calculate and apply the per-unit invoice discount difference to project posting
The fix accounts for indirect costs, prices including VAT, and currency conversions
Item lines were not affected by the bug and remain unchanged
The fix applies across all localization layers (W1, NA, BE, CH, ES, FI, GB, IT, RU, APAC)
